camel_example: aliyun resourcedirectorymaster ListTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 1098000 --Tag.1.Key k1 --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --MaxResults 10 --Tag.1.Value v1 --ResourceType Account --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the tags that are added to the members in a resource directory
description_zh: 调用ListTagResources查询资源目录成员绑定的标签列表
kebab_example: aliyun resourcedirectorymaster list-tag-resources --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --max-results 10 --tag Value=v1 Key=k1 --resource-id 1098000 --resource-type Account --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en: The token that is used to start the next query
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页时每页显示的数据行数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The tags. This parameter specifies a filter condition for the query.

You can specify a maximum of 20 tags
parameters.help_zh:
标签。查询的过滤条件。

最多可以指定20个标签
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account IDs of the members. This parameter specifies a filter condition for the query.

If you want to query the tags that are added to the members in a resource directory, you must configure both the `ResourceId` and `ResourceType` parameters and set the `ResourceType` parameter to `Account` in your request
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员ID。查询的过滤条件。

查询资源目录成员绑定的标签列表时，必须同时指定`ResourceId`和`ResourceType`，且`ResourceType`取值为`Account`
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the objects whose tags you want to query. This parameter specifies a filter condition for the query. Valid values:

Account: member
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。查询的过滤条件。取值：

Account：查询资源目录成员的标签
parameters.name: resource_type
